title: pengzhang91/Feige
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of the sharp unit-slack (delta = 1) small-deviation inequality for sums of independent nonnegative random variables. For every positive integer n and every independent family X_1, ..., X_n of measurable, integrable, nonnegative random variables satisfying E[X_i] <= 1, writing S = sum_i X_i, it proves the sharp bound P(S < E[S] + 1) >= (n / (n + 1))^n and proves that this constant is optimal for each fixed n. This optimal dimension-dependent bound strengthens and implies Feige's 1/e conjecture. The repository also formalizes the Vlassis-Thomas exact calibration theorem and Grünbaum's centroid-halfspace inequality used in the proof.
